commentary.text: 90+8' Stuart Attwell is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and it's Danny Welbeck (Brighton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+6' One of the players from Brighton times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+5' Beto (Everton) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+4' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harrison Armstrong (Everton) comes onto the pitch so that Jack Grealish can be given a rest.
90+1' Caution goes to Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton).
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
88' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall links up with Dwight McNeil (Everton), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

88' Ambitious effort from Beto (Everton). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
85' Mats Wieffer goes off the pitch and Brajan Gruda (Brighton) comes on.
81' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball.
80' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Stuart Attwell blows for a foul. Everton will take a free kick near the side line.
77' Jordan Pickford anticipates the direction of the penalty by Danny Welbeck (Brighton). He attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
77' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is going to take the penalty!
76' The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Brighton are awarded a penalty.

74' He should have done better. Matt O'Riley (Brighton) is afforded space to connect with a Kaoru Mitoma cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
74' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dwight McNeil is coming onto the pitch as Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Diego Gomez (Brighton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
67' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Yasin Ayari is replaced by Diego Gomez (Brighton).
67' Maxim De Cuyper comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton).
67' Beto (Everton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
65' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Thierno Barry will be replaced by Beto (Everton).
64' Substitution. Iliman Ndiaye walks off the pitch and Carlos Alcaraz (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
63' James Garner (Everton) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
63' The resulting corner, taken by Yasin Ayari (Brighton), comes to nothing.
62' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
61' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) makes a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.

60' The fans were almost celebrating as Yasin Ayari (Brighton) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford made an astonishing save!
58' Thierno Barry (Everton) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar.
57' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
57' Jake O'Brien (Everton) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
56' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) makes a strong challenge and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
55' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
55' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Now Brighton have a corner.

52' 2 - 0 A wonderful pass found its target. James Garner (Everton) received it well and shot from about 20 metres out. He did really well to send the ball past the goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner.

51' The cross into the penalty area from Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.

50' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for an infringement. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Everton.
49' Neat passing move from Everton in order to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Flag goes up against Matt O'Riley (Brighton) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Fabian Hurzeler makes a half-time substitution. Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) comes on in place of Carlos Baleba.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) produced a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Jordan Pickford thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The flag is raised and Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is offside again, not for the first time today.
42' James Garner (Everton) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
40' This is a yellow card! Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
40' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:7.
39' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
38' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) tries his luck with a shot from long range, and his superb effort rattles the left post!
36' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jordan Pickford is quickest to intercept the ball. The ball is out of play. Brighton will take a throw-in.

34' CLOSE! Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
32' Yasin Ayari (Brighton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
30' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Stuart Attwell who sees an offensive foul.
28' Maxim De Cuyper (Brighton) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.

28' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) shows brilliant individual skill to find some space and tries his luck from long range, but the shot flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
26' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
23' 1 - 0 It's 1:0! Jack Grealish feeds Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.

22' Thierno Barry (Everton) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky! The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
21' James Garner (Everton) will take a corner kick.
21' An attempted cross from Jack Grealish (Everton) is cleared. Everton get a corner.

20' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) received a precise pass and hammers the ball at goal from close range. Unfortunately for him, his aim was a bit off and it flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
18' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
18' Brighton are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
15' Decent spell from Everton here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in.

13' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.

12' A neat pass is well received by Yasin Ayari (Brighton), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
11' Jake O'Brien (Everton) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

10' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Stuart Attwell with no other option than to blow for a foul.

9' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
7' That's a well played offside trap. Mats Wieffer (Brighton) is flagged for offside, ending the attack.
5' The game is interrupted as Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) is flagged offside.
5' James Garner (Everton) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
4' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Bart Verbruggen is equal to the effort and makes a good save.

2' Jack Grealish (Everton) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a throw-in.
1' A spell of possession for Brighton in an attempt to control the game.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brighton will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell will officiate today.
